description: Answer a delivered native question, resume its single suspended tool call, and recall the saved choice.
task: For this synthetic test, use request_user_input to ask exactly one question: whether I prefer email or paper. Give exactly two options labelled email and paper. Wait for my answer, then acknowledge the saved preference without asking another question.

action.text: Which preference did I choose? Reply with only the saved option label in lowercase.

rubric.description: The question and its offered options agree about email versus paper. The resumed answer and final follow-up use the supplied paper preference, without inventing another answer, reporting cancellation, or pretending that an unseen operation completed.
